title: Feature Engineering Project Specification 0.2.0
description: Self-contained portable feature engineering specification. JSON Schema checks structure; normative semantic checks and adapter conformance remain mandatory.

spec_version.description: This archive version of the specification.

relationships.description: First-class source relationships, inactive until explicitly joined.

deployments.description: Declarative physical bindings and operational expectations.

identifier.description: Stable lower-case identifier. IDs are unique within each top-level collection; one version of an ID may occur in a project.

columnName.description: Logical column or entity-key name, independent of physical SQL quoting.

version.description: Exact semantic version. Ranges, wildcards and mutable latest aliases are forbidden.

utcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with a literal Z suffix and at most microsecond precision (six fractional digits); quoted in YAML. Gregorian validity is also checked by a format-aware validator.

date.description: ISO calendar date, quoted in YAML.

sha256.description: Lower-case SHA-256 digest of immutable artifact bytes.

scalar.description: JSON-compatible scalar value. NaN, infinity, timestamps as native YAML objects, and nested structures are excluded.

row.description: A synthetic fixture row. Semantic validation checks exact column names, required fields, nullability and logical types against the referenced source or entity.

extensions.description: Only escape hatch for non-core metadata. Keys use a reverse-domain namespace and colon, for example org.example:ticket. Extensions do not change baseline execution semantics.

logicalType.description: Portable scalar logical type. Integers are signed 64-bit at runtime; floating numbers must be finite binary64 values. Decimal, array and map types require a future version or explicit custom contract.

boundary.description: Whether an instant equal to this bound is eligible.

featureRef.description: Feature reference pinned to an exact declared version.

namedFeatureRef.description: Feature selection pinned to an exact declared version.

featureSetRef.description: Feature set pinned to an exact declared version.

codeProvenance.description: Auditable origin of user-controlled implementation code.

uri.description: Repository or package URI; never embedded source code or credentials.

revision.description: Immutable source revision or release digest.

description.description: Project purpose, scope and important assumptions.

owners.description: Owners who review changes and incidents.

status.description: Lifecycle state; reviewed does not grant deployment permission.

description.description: Meaning, provenance and any special interpretation of this column.

nullable.description: Whether a physical null is allowed. Required fixture columns must still be present.

unit.description: Unambiguous unit, including currency and scale, or null when unitless. Example: USD_cent.

classification.description: Data sensitivity used by adapters and access policy.

revisionOrder.description: One component of a lexicographically ordered revision selector.

direction.description: Larger revision values win after availability filtering.

revision.description: Versioned-row reconstruction contract. Retractions must be visible in the retained revision log.

order_by.description: Deterministic total ordering within each logical key. A remaining tie is an error.

selection.description: Filter by source availability, select a revision, then apply retraction, event-time and business filters.

tombstone_column.description: Optional boolean deletion marker. A selected tombstone removes the logical row.

tombstone_value.description: Value marking a retraction. Baseline requires true.

recordSemantics.description: Supported source storage semantics. Snapshot-only reads cannot claim arbitrary historical reproducibility.

oneOf.description: Immutable events or immutable entity-registration rows.

duplicate_policy.description: Reject duplicate primary keys or collapse only byte-equivalent logical values; conflicting duplicates always fail.

oneOf.description: Bitemporal record history with availability and explicit revisions.

kind.description: Rows are revisions of logical records.

logical_key.description: Columns identifying a revision family, including interval identity for historical dimensions.

duplicate_policy.description: Applied to physical primary-key duplicates before revision selection.

sourceTime.description: Two independent clocks; event time never substitutes for availability.

event_time.description: Timestamp of the business event or interval start.

available_time.description: Earliest UTC instant this exact revision became readable by the feature system.

null_key_policy.description: Null primary, logical and mapped entity keys are rejected.

invalid_row_policy.description: Malformed source records cannot silently disappear.

max_lateness_seconds.description: Operational arrival-lag expectation, not a change to event eligibility.

completeness.description: A declaration of how completeness evidence is obtained; an empty result is not evidence.

mode.description: Completeness must be supplied by a trusted adapter or persisted observation.

description.description: What proves the event-time interval complete and how outages or unknown coverage are represented.

sourceRetention.description: Declared evidence retention. Adapters must verify actual retention before historical execution.

raw_seconds.description: Minimum retained raw-event history in elapsed seconds.

revision_history_seconds.description: Minimum retained revision and retraction history in elapsed seconds.

earliest_reproducible_at.description: Earliest as-of time whose source-as-known reconstruction is supported by retained history.

upstreamColumn.description: Column-level origin of a source field.

origin.description: Human-readable table.column origin or synthetic origin statement.

description.description: How upstream data produces this source column.
Upstream source provenance and transformations before this logical table.

upstream_columns.description: Origin for every declared source column; checked semantically.

source.description: Logical read-only table. Physical coordinates are deployment bindings.

description.description: Business meaning, row grain and trust assumptions.

primary_key.description: Physical unique key, including revision discriminator when versioned.

description.description: Meaning and scope of this entity key.

source_column.description: Column in the population source that supplies this canonical key.

is_tenant.description: Whether this key separates tenants. Tenant keys participate in every grouping, join, dependency and publication lookup.

population.description: Explicit entity universe. Absence of facts does not remove an otherwise eligible entity.

source.description: Read-only source defining eligible entity existence.

mode.description: Reconstruct available source rows, enforce source event-time cutoff and tombstones, then project full entity keys. Reject duplicate mapped keys after reconstruction; population-source grain must identify one current row per entity.

deletion_policy.description: A selected population tombstone excludes that entity.

description.description: Business definition and population scope.

keys.description: Ordered composite identity; every component is mandatory.

relationshipEndpoint.description: Source and join columns for one side of a relationship.

columns.description: Ordered join-key components; pair by position with the opposite endpoint.

relationshipTemporal.description: Temporal relationship semantics, active only when an explicit transform join uses this relationship.

mode.description: No dimension valid-time interval; source availability still applies.

oneOf.description: Bitemporal target reconstruction, then half-open valid-time interval matching.

reference.description: Use the left fact row event time as the dimension valid-time probe.

valid_to.description: Target exclusive end timestamp; a null end means positive infinity.

available_time_cutoff.description: Target revision availability must be eligible at feature as-of, independently of the valid-time probe.

relationship.description: Directed, first-class source relationship. It is metadata until explicitly used by a feature join.

description.description: Business meaning, key mapping and intended use.

cardinality.description: Portable baseline prohibits fanout. Cardinality is validated over eligible rows.

join_type.description: Left preserves unmatched facts; inner removes them.

null_keys.description: Null join keys never compare equal, including two nulls.

unmatched.description: Required behavior when the target has no eligible match.

multiple_matches.description: Overlapping intervals and ambiguous target matches fail; arbitrary first-row selection is forbidden.

literal.description: A scalar constant with an explicit logical type.

expression.description: Portable typed expression AST. Three-valued null logic and operator arities are specified normatively.

input.description: Feature input alias, not a global source ID.

kind.description: Read a pinned, same-entity feature dependency.

oneOf.description: Structured computation; no SQL, Python or executable template strings.

operator.description: Fixed operator vocabulary. Arity and type compatibility are semantic validation rules.

input.description: Declared source dependency with an explicit column allowlist.

alias.description: Unique local alias used in expressions and joins.

source.description: Exact source ID declared by this project.

columns.description: All accessed columns, including reconstruction, time, grouping, join and completeness metadata when column-backed.

dependency.description: Exact dependency pin. Cross-entity or resampled dependencies require a future contract.

alignment.description: Dependency is evaluated for exactly the same composite entity and as-of instant.

window.description: Event window bounds: lower = as_of minus lookback_seconds; upper = as_of.

lookback_seconds.description: Elapsed event-time lookback from feature as-of, with no calendar arithmetic.

featureTime.description: The feature clock contract. Serving replay is a consumer selection mode, not a different mathematical feature definition.

availability.description: Availability eligibility, evaluated before revision selection.

cutoff.description: Source availability cutoff equals feature as-of.

knowledge_mode.description: Canonical recomputation reconstructs source knowledge available at feature as-of.

publication.description: Publication expectation, separate from event and source-availability eligibility.

delay_seconds.description: Expected operational latency after computation. This is an SLO/simulation parameter; historical replay requires observed published_at and must never derive it from this delay.

join.description: Explicit activation of a declared relationship; aliases must bind its directed endpoints.

entity_key.description: Canonical key in the feature entity.

column.description: Source column mapped to the entity key.

joins.description: Ordered join stages before the business filter.

filter.description: Optional boolean business filter. Only true rows pass; false and null do not.

operation.description: Exact portable aggregation; approximate algorithms are not permitted.

value.description: Value expression for sum/mean/min/max; null for row count and count_distinct.

distinct_by.description: Distinct tuple expressions, required only for count_distinct.

nulls.description: Null value handling; count counts eligible rows and count_distinct excludes tuples containing null when ignore.

kind.description: Elapsed seconds since the latest eligible event.

event_time.description: Timestamp on the primary input used for latest-event selection.

rounding.description: Floor nonnegative elapsed seconds after exact timestamp subtraction; for example, 59.9 seconds yields 59.

lookup.description: Deterministic single-row lookup within the feature window.

kind.description: Select one eligible row per entity.

order_by.description: Deterministic total ordering; remaining ties are errors.

expressionTransform.description: Derived feature. Source-column nodes are forbidden here; declare source transforms separately.

kind.description: Compute an entity-level expression from pinned features and literals.

artifact.description: Immutable fitted artifact with leakage-relevant fitting boundaries.

uri.description: Immutable model/scaler artifact URI; actual physical authorization is an adapter concern.

format.description: Artifact serialization format; runtime capability must support it.

training_cutoff.description: Latest business timestamp eligible for fitting.

training_available_cutoff.description: Latest source-availability timestamp eligible for fitting.

split_id.description: Evaluation/training split to which this fitted artifact belongs.

fitting.description: Fit-time provenance, separate from apply-time inputs.

policy.description: Fit only from the named training split; never refit on evaluation or production inputs.

description.description: Exact fit procedure, sampling policy and leakage safeguards.

contractInput.description: Named, typed input to an external computation contract.

nullable.description: Whether contract accepts a null argument.

contract.description: Typed execution boundary. Schema validity does not establish behavioral correctness of arbitrary code.

entrypoint.description: Logical operation symbol, not inline executable code.

output_nullable.description: Whether adapter may produce a null.

deterministic.description: Whether equal inputs and the pinned artifact guarantee equal outputs.

side_effects.description: Feature execution cannot send messages or mutate unrelated systems.

network_access.description: Baseline execution sandbox has no network access.

null_policy.description: Null input contract; handled requires documented behavior.

description.description: Precise algorithm, units, null behavior, failure behavior and deterministic assumptions.

learned.description: Fitted transform contract. The shipped reference verifier deliberately does not execute model artifacts.

kind.description: Apply an immutable artifact fitted separately on a training split.

required_capabilities.description: Explicit adapter capabilities that must be checked before planning.

conformance_suite.description: Acceptance suite containing golden application behavior.

custom.description: Escape boundary for non-portable computation; never treat schema validation as code verification.

kind.description: Execute separately reviewed custom code via a capability-gated adapter.

required_capabilities.description: Explicit adapter capabilities needed for this operation.

conformance_suite.description: Golden behavior and failure cases for the adapter.

nullable.description: Whether the published value may be null for any declared state.

unit.description: Output unit and scale, or null for unitless output.

description.description: Human-readable output meaning including window and population.

constraints.description: Optional output domain constraints; type compatibility checked semantically.

numeric_tolerance.description: Tolerance for numeric comparison. Integer results require zero tolerance.

relative.description: Maximum relative golden-test error, evaluated against expected magnitude.

lineageEntry.description: An output-to-source-column lineage edge, including implicit temporal and revision fields.

items.description: How this source field affects the result.

roles.description: All applicable uses of this column.

description.description: Why this field is necessary for output value or eligibility.
How the dependent output contributes to this output.

sources.description: Complete directly read source columns, plus population dependencies. Transitive feature lineage is resolved through dependency edges.

dependencies.description: Every declared feature dependency must have a lineage explanation.

code.description: Immutable code provenance when custom computation requires it.

emptyPolicy.description: Applies only when completeness is established and no eligible input remains.

action.description: Emit a documented empty-population identity value.
Emit null for a known-empty input.

missingness.description: Distinct absence, incompleteness, outage and execution-failure semantics.

null_input.description: Must agree with the chosen transform null contract.

insufficient_history.description: Behavior when required contiguous history is unproven.

source_unavailable.description: Behavior when a required source is unavailable.

execution_failure.description: Execution failure is a diagnostic and can never become a default feature value.

kind.description: Require a non-null output in successful states.

on_violation.description: Failure behavior; quarantine must not be published as successful data.

required_seconds.description: Required contiguous event history before as-of. Must cover the feature window when coverage is contiguous.

coverage.description: A complete contiguous event-time window must be proven by persisted evidence. Partial-coverage outputs require a future explicit contract.

earliest_as_of.description: Earliest supported feature as-of after retention and history requirements.

featureAcceptance.description: Human-readable conformance intent plus suite references.

suites.description: Acceptance suite IDs governing this feature.

description.description: Coverage objective and known limits of the declared suite.

feature.description: Versioned feature definition, independent of a physical execution environment.

description.description: Business definition and precise behavioral purpose.

inputs.description: Direct source inputs; expression-only features normally use an empty list.

description.description: Purpose and compatibility promise.

features.description: Pinned feature membership; all members share the declared entity.

publication.description: All values in one entity/as-of snapshot become visible together.

entityInput.description: Mapping from request schema to canonical entity identity.

label.description: Separate future label contract. Label values cannot enter feature inputs or fitting before their declared availability.

horizon_seconds.description: Forward label observation horizon from the feature as-of.

availability_policy.description: Only labels available by the separately supplied dataset cutoff are eligible.

description.description: Target construction, censoring and label aggregation semantics.

aggregation.description: Exact target construction over eligible future label rows. latest requires a unique latest event timestamp; ties fail.

empty.description: Value for a proven complete horizon containing no eligible label rows.

incomplete_horizon.description: Censor incomplete observations explicitly; never turn an incomplete horizon into a negative/zero label.

full_horizon_required.description: The dataset cutoff and independent source completeness evidence must cover the entire forward label horizon.

consumer.description: Explicit training, batch or serving feature consumer.

description.description: Use case, entity/time request meaning and operational assumptions.

as_of.description: Request field defining event and source-knowledge cutoff.

requested_at.description: Request field defining publication visibility cutoff.

dataset_cutoff.description: Optional request field for label availability cutoff.

selection.description: Selection semantics for materialized feature values.

mode.description: Recompute canonical source knowledge or select actual publications that existed at request time.

tie_breaker.description: Select maximal as_of, then published_at, then sequence; duplicate ordering keys are errors.

max_staleness_seconds.description: Maximum request as-of minus selected value as-of; exceeding it is a stale diagnostic.

missing_value_policy.description: No undeclared imputation or fallback to an older non-null publication.

physicalLocation.description: Credential-free coordinates interpreted by the selected adapter, never by feature semantics. Locations grant no I/O authority.

format.description: Adapter-validated format identifier such as parquet, csv, or jsonl.

oneOf.description: Generic table coordinates; Databricks interprets two namespace components as catalog and schema.

namespace.description: Ordered namespace components; arbitrary depth, including an empty sequence.

format.description: Adapter-validated format identifier; Delta is not a core-language requirement.

oneOf.description: Opaque provider resource, including stores without SQL table namespaces.

uri.description: Credential-free opaque URI. Never fetch merely because it appears in a contract.

oneOf.description: Synthetic fixture binding used only by local conformance tools.

sourceBinding.description: One logical source bound to a physical read-only dataset.

outputTarget.description: Physical destination for a pinned feature set.

write_mode.description: Adapter write strategy; retries must preserve idempotent publication identity.

feature_mapping.description: Exact feature-set membership; each value and state is mapped once.

offset_seconds.description: Offset from the UTC epoch; must be less than every_seconds.

allowed.description: Backfill permitted only within these explicit bounds.

mode.description: Backfill cannot fabricate historical publication evidence.

publish.description: Historical recomputations never silently overwrite observed serving history.

deployment.description: Environment-specific execution intent and bindings. This document does not execute or authorize a deployment.

description.description: Intended environment and capability assumptions; descriptive configuration is not deployment authorization.

lookback_seconds.description: Revisit horizon for late arrivals and corrections.

late_arrival_policy.description: Behavior when newly available evidence changes earlier computations.

visibility.description: Only committed, quality-passing runs become visible.

observed_timestamp_required.description: Persist actual published_at; expected delay is not historical evidence.

surface.description: Required visibility surface. Offline commit evidence does not establish online serving visibility.

sdk_policy.description: Resolve exact SDK/runtime versions and supported APIs at implementation time; do not infer support from this file.

required_capabilities.description: Required adapter capabilities. The planner also derives requirements from operations; listing a subset cannot disable checks.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code for the declared cost budget.

max_daily_cost.description: Maximum planned daily execution cost; example values are synthetic.

max_scan_bytes.description: Maximum input bytes scanned per run.

max_output_rows.description: Maximum feature rows emitted per run.

alert_owner.description: Accountable alert recipient identity; no message is sent by this specification.

access.description: Credential-free authorization intent; identities and grants must be verified in the target environment.

read_principal.description: Non-secret identity used to read bound sources.

write_principal.description: Non-secret identity used to publish outputs.

resource.description: Explicit logical or physical resource identifier.

privilege.description: Minimum required permission; no wildcard administrative grant.

required_permissions.description: Permissions that the adapter must verify before execution.

purpose.description: Approved data-use purpose for source access and output publication.

output_retention_seconds.description: Minimum retained publication and audit history. Privacy/legal maximums must also be enforced by the organization policy.

adapters.description: Explicit implementation instances with role-scoped configuration.

execution.description: Select compute, catalog, and optional orchestration without selecting a storage vendor in logical features.

orchestrator.description: Scheduler adapter or null for externally triggered/manual execution.

consumer_bindings.description: Explicit logical-consumer to target mappings. Consumers outside this deployment may be omitted.

portability.description: Declare native escape hatches separately from portable feature meaning.

mode.description: Portable mode prohibits user-supplied target-specific native bindings. A portable request still requires capability verification.

native_bindings.description: Reviewed target-specific code bindings; each keeps the referenced logical feature semantics.

outputState.description: Observable output state. A null value must not erase the reason for absence.

publication.description: Immutable observed publication. Selection includes nulls and enforces max staleness.

sourceStatus.description: Explicit source health and completeness evidence for a fixture.

oneOf.description: Completeness envelope [coverage_start, coverage_end) independent of row count.

state.description: The source can be read and this complete event-time interval is proven.
Source cannot be read; no row-count inference is allowed.

caseContext.description: Synthetic execution evidence. Fixtures must not assume empty sources prove completeness.

source_status.description: Explicit status for all directly and transitively used sources, including populations.

evaluation_completed_at.description: Observed completion time for a synthetic run, separate from publication.

published_values.description: Actual synthetic publication history used only by replay fixtures.

consumer.description: Optional consumer whose staleness and missing-value rules apply.

capabilities.description: Available capabilities for deliberate preflight or adapter contract tests.

split_id.description: Fit/apply split identity for learned adapter tests.

expectation.description: Exactly one success result or diagnostic expectation.

rows.description: Expected output rows; each eligible population entity appears exactly once.

diagnostic.description: Expected failure, rather than an invented null/default result.

description.description: What semantic edge this synthetic fixture proves.

population_rows.description: Synthetic canonical entity rows. Must equal the entity keys reconstructed from the supplied population source rows.

source_rows.description: Synthetic physical rows keyed by logical source ID; every transitive source and population source must have an entry, even if empty.

description.description: Scope, limitations and the independent reasoning behind golden expectations.

runner.description: Whether the bundled limited verifier can execute this suite or an external adapter is required.

adapterRole.description: Independent adapter responsibility; several roles may be provided by one package.

adapterImplementation.description: Reverse-domain adapter implementation identifier. Names do not imply installation or support.

adapterInstance.description: Pinned deployment-local adapter instance. SDK/build pins and evidence are resolved separately at implementation time.

roles.description: Roles this adapter is requested to provide; planning must independently verify them.

configuration.description: Credential-free adapter configuration. The selected adapter must validate this against its own exact-version schema before planning or execution. Core validation does not interpret these values.

physicalColumnMap.description: Complete one-to-one logical-field to physical-field mapping. Names only: no casts, expressions, defaults, or unit conversion.

additionalProperties.description: Physical column or record-field name; quoting/encoding belongs to the adapter.

outputFeatureMapping.description: Map a pinned logical feature and its state to distinct physical fields.

state_column.description: Physical state field; null does not encode missingness state by itself.

publicationColumns.description: Physical fields carrying original publication evidence and current materialization identity.

published_at.description: Original observed visibility timestamp field; never fabricated during backfill/import.

materialization_id.description: Current write/import execution identity field; distinct from original publication identity.

consumerBinding.description: Resolve a logical consumer to an output target without rewriting the consumer contract.

role.description: Selected retrieval surface. The selected output target must contain the pinned feature set.

capabilityRequirement.description: A requirement, never evidence that an adapter supports it.

reason.description: Why this capability is required and which contract behavior depends on it.

nativeBinding.description: Explicit target-specific implementation preserving the referenced feature contract; metadata extensions cannot carry executable semantics.

required_capabilities.description: Each capability must also be required for the same adapter and role.

migration_notes.description: Nonportable dependencies, replacement requirements, and validation needed on another adapter.

reportEvidence.description: Immutable evidence reference. Remote references are not fetched during validation.

uri.description: Evidence URI; normally a local report or a controlled evidence-store record.

description.description: What the evidence demonstrates, including its limits.

adapterAssessment.description: Resolved adapter identity recorded by a capability assessment.

implementation_sha256.description: Exact installed build digest, or null when unverified.

runtime_versions.description: Actual SDK/runtime version pins; empty if not observed.

capabilityCheck.description: One assessed capability for one exact adapter and role.

status.description: Capability result. Input declarations cannot establish support.

evidence_scope.description: Where evidence was obtained; a mock is never a live-target result.

evidence.description: Immutable supporting evidence. Supported claims require at least one item.

capabilityReport.description: Capability assessment tied to exact project bytes, deployment, adapters, and evidence; not a deployment command.

execution_scope.description: External execution readiness requires live-target evidence for every mandatory capability.

adapters.description: Exact deployment adapter instances; never infer installed support from requested versions.

checks.description: Complete assessment of explicit and planner-derived required capabilities.

execution_ready.description: Computed readiness. False for unsupported/unverified required capabilities and for external requirements without live evidence.
